tasks.short: Document music therapy evaluations and plans

steps.what: Verify evaluations, treatment decisions, sources and reporting purpose
Draft reports from the verified brief

loop.check: Therapist checks observation versus interpretation, omissions, uncertainty and treatment intent against sources
loop.stop: One revision then manual drafting if meaning remains wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative observations need contextual wording beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Correct and accept the final report into the clinical record

tasks.design: Use the {DOCS} template and a bounded narrative draft from the therapist's verified brief. The therapist checks and accepts the report into {OTHER}, the clinical record system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Templates could not turn varied observations into faithful narrative.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can reduce first-pass prose work.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing observed response from clinical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The therapist owns assessment and treatment decisions.
tasks.altitude: A little less prose drafting; clinical authority stays with the therapist.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber supports clinician-validated clinical notes; this is adjacent capability, not evidence for music therapy accuracy or savings.
The proposed report split and savings are unmeasured scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is report preparation; clinical assessment and live observation are separate tasks.

The therapist produces client identifier, session date, source references, observed responses, agreed goals and treatment decisions in s1; all capture and verification time remains. Missing fields are resolved manually before drafting.
Test native clinical-record templates and draft facilities before custom integration.
No recordings or inferred musical meaning are required. Other-role source correction allowance is additional.
unknowns: Existing report template and permitted draft tooling
research_questions: Does first-pass drafting reduce total time after meaning checks?

incremental.description: Template maintenance and sampled error review

approvals.approved_version: Exact client, dated narrative, goals and source snapshot; any edit voids acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 minus6 upkeep gives net6. Range0-2 allows slow verification of ambiguous responses or little prose reuse.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess client functioning, strengths and needs through responsive therapeutic interaction

tasks.design: Keep assessment with the therapist. The {OTHER} clinical record may display existing history, but this proposal changes no assessment step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Abilities emerge through context and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidenced replacement for therapeutic assessment is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting prompts and interpreting variable responses.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and distinguish inability from unfamiliarity or distress.
tasks.altitude: Assessment time and decision rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Responsive assessment requires situated clinical judgement; no labour saving is proposed.

assumptions: Boundary is direct assessment, excluding report preparation.
The therapist elicits and interprets responses during s1; no structured ability scores or outside capture are assumed.
Check existing clinical-record display before adding software; none is proposed.
Zero upkeep because this design adds no tooling or procedure.
research_questions: Which assessment observations are difficult to interpret consistently?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; responsive assessment remains throughout.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe client reactions and document contextual responses during music therapy

tasks.design: Retain live observation and brief contemporaneous documentation. Any later narrative report in {DOCS} belongs to the report task and receives no second saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: A response has meaning within the therapeutic encounter.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capture tool is justified by the supplied evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing subtle changes while maintaining engagement.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret response in relation to the client's own baseline.
tasks.altitude: The therapist remains present for the full observation task.

evidence.claim: Automated narrative drafting does not establish accurate observation of musical or nonverbal responses.

assumptions: Boundary is live observation and immediate notes; later reports are counted separately.
The therapist produces date, activity, observed response and context during s1; full capture time remains and no automated response flags are assumed.
Use existing note facilities before considering custom tools.
Zero upkeep because no changed system or workflow is introduced.
research_questions: Can existing note conventions improve continuity without distracting from clients?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0 with no upkeep; observation and immediate capture remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Improvise instrumentally, vocally or physically in response to the client

tasks.design: Keep improvisation in the therapeutic relationship. Existing goals in {OTHER}, the clinical record, inform the therapist without directing live musical choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is immediate relational performance.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied capability replaces responsive therapeutic improvisation.
tasks.still_hard: Adjusting timing, intensity and musical response safely.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to the person's cues with musical skill and care.
tasks.altitude: Live improvisation time and responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Live therapeutic improvisation is situated human work, with no demonstrated replacement in this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is live improvisation, excluding planning and reports.
The therapist interprets client cues in s1; no free structured emotional or safety input is assumed.
Existing goal display suffices; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep follows from leaving the method unchanged.
research_questions: What cues cause the therapist to alter or stop improvisation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; the complete responsive performance remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less first-pass report prose where verified observations exist; full responsibility for care remains.
reach: Coordinate observation language with nursing colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A therapist with clearer records and the same responsibility for live care.
